income.source: U.S. Census Bureau SAIPE via USDA ERS

pell.definition: Average share of first-time, full-time freshmen receiving Pell Grants (IPEDS 2022–23) at the in-state colleges a county’s new freshmen attended, weighted by how many enrolled at each. Describes those colleges, not whether the county’s own students received Pell.
pell.GA: Georgia: in-state first-time freshmen at the 26 University System of Georgia institutions, Fall 2024 (USG SRPT405a). Excludes technical, private, and out-of-state colleges.
pell.MD: Maryland: new full-time undergraduates at Maryland four-year public and private nonprofit institutions, Fall 2025 (MHEC Enrollment by Place of Residence). Excludes community colleges and out-of-state colleges.

top20.definition: U.S. News 2027 Best National Universities ranked #1–#20 (22 schools incl. ties). Freshmen who graduated high school in the past 12 months, by state of residence, at every U.S. college (IPEDS EF2022C, fall 2022).

md_unmatched_institutions: Women’s Institute of Torah Seminary & College
meta.caution: The two states’ county data come from different agencies, years, and sets of colleges, so county Pell values are best compared within a state. Income uses the same source and scale for both.
